Name: Harpy Strike
Components: M (the weapon used to make the attack)
Description:
Moving like the winds themselves, you teleport to an unoccupied space within the spell’s range, then make a single weapon attack against a creature within range using this spell’s material component. If it hits, the attack’s damage cannot be resisted and ignores Damage Thresholds. Creatures cannot take reactions in response to this attack.

Sword Saint Bonus. When this spell is cast by a sword saint, it is treated as being cast one level higher. This spell is also treated as being on the class spell list(s) of any creature who has at least three levels in sword saint.
At Higher Levels:
When you cast this spell at 3rd level or higher, it gains one of the following effects for each level above 2nd:
● The spell’s range increases by 30 feet.
● One attack made a part of this spell has advantage.
● (2 levels) Choose one additional target within the spell’s range; you teleport to them and make an additional attack against them before moving to your intended space.
